item.title: Behind Every Login: Why I Enjoy Identity Operations
item.description:
Some days in IT operations begin with a tidy sprint board. Other days begin with a login problem, an urgent access request, and three people asking whether it is related to the change from yesterday. Usually, the answer is: let’s take a look.

I actually enjoy this mix. Identity work brings together technical problem-solving, security, user experience, automation, and teamwork. A login may look like one small action, but making it feel that simple takes a surprising amount of thoughtful work behind the scenes.

item.title: How This Website Works: Hugo + GitHub Actions + Cloudflare Architecture
item.description: This website is built using a modern static site architecture that combines Hugo, GitHub Actions, and Cloudflare to deliver fast, secure, and automated deployments. Here’s how everything works together.

item.title: Stepping Outside My Comfort Zone: What I Learned Working in Roofing
item.description:
At CK Roofing, I stepped out of the IT world and into a fast-moving service business — bringing my tech skills with me to improve day-to-day operations, automate client workflows, and support both office and field teams.

What started as a temporary pivot turned into an intense and valuable learning experience that sharpened my customer communication, team collaboration, and operational mindset.

item.title: Six Years as Sole IT Administrator: Building and Maintaining Infrastructure for a Growing Startup
item.description: As the sole in-house IT administrator at Praedicat, I was fully responsible for managing and maintaining the company’s IT infrastructure across multiple locations. My role combined hands-on technical support with long-term infrastructure planning, ensuring system reliability, security, and scalability for a growing organization.
